trap: A stale timing item used as a plug. Ledger row L9, a 4,000.00 cash-sales deposit dated 3 April, never reaches the bank by 30 April. A 27-day-old deposit in transit is an unrecorded-deposit or lapping signal, not timing: it must default to investigate and block RECONCILED. A timing item carried from last month that still has not cleared is also investigate.
